big_case.notes: An imminent execution creates exceptional individual stakes and a categorical clemency-policy challenge could reach beyond this applicant. The staged resolution is nevertheless a case-specific stay denial without a stated new rule or demonstrated broader doctrinal effect.

leakage.notes: All 14 log calls have captured results. Queries concern supplied files, statpack context, prior denials, and a companion-petition query reported as a usage error. No query or prose shows this application's November 5 disposition before the November 4 forecast. Null document dates alone are not proof of clean retrieval; the call subjects and reasoning support the assessment.
